title: “The Pope, the Plates, and the Prophetic Tremor — We’re Not Just Watching History, We’re Ignoring Heaven”
paragraphs:
“The Pope, the Plates, and the Prophetic Tremor — We’re Not Just Watching History, We’re Ignoring Heaven”
(📛 The ground isn’t groaning for political reform. It’s groaning for repentance.)

The earth just groaned. The church barely blinked.
A pope resigns. The soil ruptures. But instead of altars… we refresh feeds.
God is shaking the land and the leadership — because judgment begins at the house of God.

📛 This is not coincidence.
🔥 This is convergence.

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, do earthquakes and religious leadership changes really mean something prophetically?”

✅ Answer:
Yes. Because when both the earthly ground and the spiritual governance shake at once,
🔥 it’s not just a signal — it’s a sentence.

📛 God isn’t just correcting.
🔥 He’s calling for repentance — before the final tremor drops.

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE — Hebrews 12:26–27 (KJV):
“Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven... that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-12-26_12-27/

💥 He’s not shaking to scare you.
🔥 He’s shaking to strip you of what cannot survive eternity.
CORE TRUTH — HEAVEN IS SHAKING WHAT MAN REFUSES TO SURRENDER

📖 Hebrews 12:26–27 (KJV)
“Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven… that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-12-26_12-27/
🔍 GREEK BREAKDOWN:

Shake = σαλεύω (saleuō)
💥 Definition: To agitate, shake violently, topple a structure
🔥 Not a soft tremble — this is a divine demolition of everything false and unstable.

Heaven = οὐρανός (ouranos)
💥 Not just “sky” — refers to the realm of spiritual authority, divine order, and angelic witness.
🔥 God is shaking not just nature — but systems, pulpits, and false thrones.

Remain = μένω (menō)
💥 To endure, abide, stand unshaken
🔥 Only what is rooted in Christ survives the shaking. Everything built on ego, empire, or error… crumbles.

📛 THEOLOGICAL TRUTH:
God always shakes foundations before judgment falls.
Before Egypt lost their firstborn — plagues hit the land.
Before Jerusalem burned — prophets screamed and were ignored.
🔥 Now both Rome and the Earth are groaning again.

This is not politics.
📛 This is prophecy.

📖 Isaiah 24:19–20 (KJV):
“The earth is utterly broken down… it shall fall, and not rise again.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-24-19_24-20/

📖 Matthew 24:7 (KJV):
“…and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-24-7/
🔥 When pestilence and plates move together — Jesus said, “Watch.”
"Brother John, does this mean Jesus is coming soon?”

✅ Direct Answer:
It means He’s already at the door.
📛 The question isn’t when He’s coming — it’s what will still be standing when He does.

⚡ Summary Strike:
God isn’t just shaking the earth —
🔥 He’s shaking popes, pulpits, platforms, and pride.
What survives the quake… proves who truly belongs to the Kingdom.
BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — EARTHQUAKES, FALSE POPES, AND HEAVEN’S FINAL SHAKING

📖 Revelation 6:12 (KJV)
“And, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-6-12/
🔥 Earthquakes in Revelation were judgment triggers — not coincidences.

📖 Acts 16:26 (KJV)
“And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Acts-16-26/
🔥 When truth is bound, God shakes the ground.
📛 This isn’t just geology. It’s divine jailbreak.

📖 Ezekiel 38:19 (KJV)
“For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ezekiel-38-19/
🔥 God's jealousy over compromised worship releases physical tremors.

📖 Revelation 11:13 (KJV)
“And the same hour was there a great earthquake… and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-11-13/
🔥 Earthquakes drive fear, not faith — unless you’re already surrendered.
✝️ EARLY CHURCH FATHERS — WARNINGS AGAINST FALSE ROME, FALSE CHURCHES, AND FALSE POWER

✝️ Tertullian (Apology, Ch. 40):
“We worship no power that crumbles under Rome. Christ’s kingdom cannot be shaken — for it is not of this world.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0301.htm
📛 Tertullian saw the rise of imperial religion… and rejected it.

✝️ Ignatius of Antioch (Letter to the Romans):
“Beware the voice that flatters Rome — for she does not weep over the cross.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0107.htm
🔥 Rome will anoint idols… but not crucify self.

✝️ Athanasius (Against the Arians):
“The church does not follow titles, but truth. And if the truth is homeless, let us be exiles with her.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/2816.htm
📛 Titles mean nothing in the quake. Only truth stands.
"Brother John, how can a Pope be part of a shaking?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Because when the church trades Christ’s authority for world approval, the earthquake becomes mercy.
📛 The shaking is not the judgment — it’s the warning.
🔥 The real judgment comes when we don’t repent after the quake.

⚡ Summary Strike:
📛 God shakes what man worships —
🔥 So only Christ remains enthroned.

If the Pope sits where Christ alone should reign —
Don’t be surprised when the earth doesn’t agree.
RESURRECTION RESPONSE CODES — I STAND WHERE ROME FALLS
🔊 “If the ground is shaking, let it. I will not move from the truth.”
🔊 “I don’t bow to popes. I bow to Christ — crucified, risen, and soon returning.”
🔊 “When Rome rebrands itself, I re-anchor myself to the cross.”
🔊 “Let the earth shake. I’ve already buried my self at Calvary.”
🔊 “Heaven isn’t moved by crowns or cathedrals — only by repentance.”
🔊 “I am not following a church that avoids the blood, the cross, or the coming fire.”
🔊 “If the shaking gets worse, it means I’m getting closer to unshakable.”
🔊 “The only throne I follow is the one that was preceded by a cross.”
📢 POST-READY FIRE DECLARATION (for Facebook/Instagram):

👉 “The earth is shaking. The popes are shifting. But I refuse to follow titles without truth.
I bow to one throne — the crucified Christ.
🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR.”
🔥 #LetRomeFall #TruthIsUnshakable #HeavenShakesHellWakes #CrossOverCrowd #NoPopesNoPrideJustChristCrucified
📎 Remnant Group Link (Always Add):
“Brother John, isn’t it extreme to call out religious leaders like the Pope?”

✅ Direct Answer:
What’s extreme is ignoring the shaking, protecting platforms, and preaching peace when God is shouting “Repent!”

📖 Jeremiah 6:14 (KJV):
“They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Jeremiah-6-14/
🔥 We don’t need smooth talkers. We need trembling prophets.

⚡ Summary Strike:
If your faith shakes when the Pope resigns or the earth cracks —
📛 It wasn’t built on the cross.
🔥 The Gospel doesn’t move when Rome falls — it rises.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — WHEN GOD SHOOK NATIONS AND THRONES

📖 Numbers 16:31–33 (KJV) — Korah's Rebellion
“And it came to pass... that the ground clave asunder that was under them: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Numbers-16-31_16-33/

💥 Korah exalted himself. God cracked the earth to end the rebellion.
📛 This wasn’t a tremor. It was a verdict.

📖 Isaiah 2:19 (KJV) — When pride is judged
“And they shall go into the holes of the rocks... for fear of the LORD... when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-2-19/

💥 The shaking targets pride — especially religious pride.
🔥 Every high place must fall.

📖 Amos 1:1 (KJV) — Before the Word, came the quake
“The words of Amos... which he saw concerning Israel... two years before the earthquake.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Amos-1-1/

💥 Prophetic fire often follows a quake.
📛 God shakes the ground to open ears.

📖 Haggai 2:6–7 (KJV) — The Final Shaking
“For thus saith the LORD of hosts... yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth... and I will shake all nations...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Haggai-2-6_2-7/

🔥 When the earth shakes — a Glory shift is near.
📛 Religious systems crumble before revival rises.
"Brother John, do earthquakes mean we’re near the end?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Not always. But when they come with rising apostasy —
🔥 It’s more than tectonic. It’s prophetic.

📖 Matthew 24:7 (KJV):
“And there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-24-7/
📛 Earthquakes + false Christs = the final countdown.

⚡ Summary Strike:
In the Old Covenant, when people refused repentance —
🔥 God shook the dirt beneath their altars.

📛 The same shaking is happening now.
Not to scare us — but to awaken us.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “WHEN THE EARTH SHOOK, SO DID MY FAITH”
🧍‍♂️ Testimony: Marco L., Naples, Italy — From Devout Catholicism to Crucified Christ

Marco was born in Rome, raised under centuries of church tradition.
He kissed relics, bowed to statues, fasted during Lent…
but he never heard the Gospel of repentance and crucifixion.

He loved the Pope.
He lit candles for Mary.
He never missed Mass.

But when the recent earthquake struck southern Italy — and his cousin died under rubble near Campi Flegrei —
Marco began to question:
“If this is God’s church… why is the ground shaking under it?”
That same night, scrolling in despair, Marco found a video preaching Luke 9:23 — in Italian:
👉 “If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.”

It crushed him.
He had spent his whole life honoring a system that never called him to the cross.
He repented.

He burned his rosaries.
He tore down the saint posters.
He deleted the prayer apps that never preached Jesus crucified.

Now Marco meets underground with three ex-Catholics in a wine cellar.
They read Scripture by candlelight.
They’ve been called “traitors” by family.
But Marco said:
🔥 “I’d rather be hated in truth than honored in deception.”

📖 Galatians 6:14 (KJV):
“…God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Galatians-6-14/
📛 No Popes. No priests. Just the cross.
"Brother John, can God use tragedy to wake people up?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes. It’s mercy in motion.
📛 Before final judgment — comes holy shaking.

📖 Hebrews 12:27 (KJV):
“…removing those things that are shaken… that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-12-27/
🔥 God shakes what’s fake — so only the true remains.

⚡ Summary Strike:
Marco lost a cousin in the quake.
But he gained the truth that will outlive every cathedral.

📛 The shaking wasn’t judgment alone —
🔥 It was an altar call with aftershocks.
FINAL CHALLENGE — WHEN THE CHURCH SHAKES, WHO DO YOU RUN TO?

📖 Hebrews 12:26–27 (KJV):
“…Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven… that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-12-26_12-27/

📛 God is shaking the Vatican.
🔥 God is shaking the pulpits.
📛 God is shaking the seminaries.
🔥 God is shaking the souls beneath the robes.

Not to destroy…
But to expose what was never built on Christ.
🧱 TRUTH STRIKE:

✔️ You can follow a pope and still miss the cross.
✔️ You can kiss icons and still be far from Jesus.
✔️ You can memorize prayers and still die in sin.
🔥 God never called you to be more Catholic. He called you to be crucified.

📖 Matthew 24:2 (KJV):
“…There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-24-2/

💥 Jesus wasn’t impressed with temples.
🔥 He prophesied their collapse — to raise a living remnant.

💭 READER FINAL QUESTION:
"Brother John, I was raised Catholic… Am I cursed if I leave it all behind?”

✅ Direct Answer:
No — you’re blessed.
📛 Your loyalty is not to a system. It’s to the Savior.

📖 Revelation 18:4 (KJV):
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-18-4/

🔥 God isn’t asking you to hate tradition.
He’s commanding you to abandon deception.

⚡ FINAL CHALLENGE STRIKE:
When God shakes a nation, it’s not political. It’s prophetic.
When He exposes religious idols, it’s not rebellion — it’s revival.

📛 Do not hide under stained glass.
🔥 Run to the cross — before the next quake hits harder.
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — THE EARTH SHAKES, WHO STILL SLEEPS?

📖 Proverbs 1:7 (KJV):
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Proverbs-1-7/

📖 Matthew 15:9 (KJV):
“But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-15-9/
📛 You can worship with candles… and still be far from Christ.
❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
“I was born Catholic, I’ll die Catholic.”
“Only the Pope can truly lead us.”
“God honors all religions. We’re all one body.”
“The Vatican is God’s holy city.”
“I trust tradition more than modern interpretation.”

🔥 Result:
The fool clings to heritage over holiness — and dies with incense instead of intimacy.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
“Jesus, You alone are the Head of the Church.”
“If You’re shaking religion, I won’t hold on — I’ll let go.”
“I want truth, even if it breaks my family’s tradition.”
“I don’t need the Vatican. I need the cross.”
“I leave the robe. I take the blood.”

🔥 Result:
The wise sees the shaking… and runs to the Rock that cannot be moved.

📖 1 Corinthians 3:11 (KJV):
“For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/1-Corinthians-3-11/

📛 Rome may fall. Cathedrals may crumble.
🔥 But the Crucified King remains — unshaken, unbending, untouchable.
"Brother John, how do I honor my upbringing without following a false gospel?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Thank God for what helped you know His name…
📛 But reject what denies His Lordship.

🔥 You are not betraying your roots.
You are bowing to the Root of David — Jesus Christ.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The fool chooses comfort in stained glass.
🔥 The wise chooses Christ — even if it costs everything.

📛 One clings to the Pope.
🔥 The other clings to the cross.
WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WOULD YOU MEET CHRIST… OR CATHEDRAL COMFORT?

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-9-27/

📛 No purgatory. No delay. No indulgence.
🔥 One death. One judgment. One Savior.

📖 John 14:6 (KJV):
“Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/John-14-6/

💥 Not Mary. Not saints.
📛 Not confession booths or Vatican doors.
🔥 Jesus — or judgment.

📖 Revelation 20:15 (KJV):
“And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-20-15/

🔥 The Lamb’s Book doesn’t record denominational membership.
It records death to self — and life in Christ.

💭 JUDGMENT QUESTION:
If the earth split under your feet tonight…

Would the angels find your name in Christ…
🔥 Or your allegiance in ritual?

Would you rise to reward…
🔥 Or fall with the system that denied Him?

Would you hear “Well done” —
🔥 Or “I never knew you”?

📛 Heaven is not Catholic. Hell is not Protestant.
🔥 Eternity only honors the crucified.
"Brother John, I was taught God understands all sincere religions. Isn’t that enough?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Sincerity doesn’t save you — the blood does.

📛 If sincerity saved, Jesus didn’t need to die.
🔥 But He did. That means every other road leads to fire.

📖 Acts 4:12 (KJV):
“Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Acts-4-12/

⚡ Summary Strike:
If you died tonight and stood before the throne…

Your priest can’t defend you.
Your rituals can’t excuse you.
🔥 Only Jesus — known, trusted, surrendered to — can rescue you.

📛 Religious comfort won’t survive the fire.
🔥 Only crucified faith will.
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — WHEN TRADITION BECOMES THE TRAP

👿 1. The “Sacrament = Salvation” Lie
“If I take communion, confess, and attend Mass… I’m safe.”

💀 Truth:
📛 Rituals don’t save. The Redeemer does.
🔥 Judas ate with Jesus — and still went to hell.

📖 1 Corinthians 11:29 (KJV):
“For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/1-Corinthians-11-29/

👿 2. The “Mary Is the Mediator” Deception
“Pray to Mary. She’ll intercede for you.”

💀 Truth:
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 (KJV):
“For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/1-Timothy-2-5/

📛 The blood of Jesus doesn’t need backup.
🔥 His cross is enough.

👿 3. The “Pope as Christ on Earth” Heresy
“The Pope is the vicar of Christ. He speaks infallibly.”

💀 Truth:
📖 Romans 3:4 (KJV):
“Let God be true, but every man a liar…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Romans-3-4/

📛 No man is infallible — only the Word is.
🔥 The real Christ doesn’t need a throne in Rome.

👿 4. The “Purgatory Hope” Trap
“If I die in sin, my family can pray me into heaven.”

💀 Truth:
📖 Luke 16:26 — A great gulf fixed. No second chance.
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-16-26/

📛 If the cross didn’t finish it, nothing else can.
🔥 Eternal destiny is sealed at your last breath.

📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 (KJV):
“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-14/
📛 Today, Satan’s disguise is not rebellion — it’s religion.
"Brother John, if I believed these things for years, am I too far gone?"

✅ Direct Answer:
No. You’re one breath of repentance away.
🔥 But you must renounce the lie — and run to the cross, not the cathedral.

📖 Ephesians 5:11 (KJV):
“And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ephesians-5-11/

⚡ Summary Strike:
Satan doesn’t care if you’re in a pew — as long as you never bow at the true altar.
📛 He loves tradition… as long as it keeps you from truth.
🔥 The smoke of incense won’t hide your sin — only the blood can wash it.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION, COMMANDER!
This is not just a prayer.
📛 This is a public renunciation of religious idolatry — and a covenant cry of allegiance to Christ alone.
🔥 No popes. No mediators. No tradition without truth. Only Jesus crucified, risen, and returning.
🔥 GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — I RENOUNCE RELIGION, I RECEIVE THE CROSS
📢 SAY THIS OUT LOUD — LET HEAVEN HEAR AND HELL TREMBLE:

“Jesus Christ,
I renounce every lie that exalted tradition over truth.
I reject every teaching that replaced You with man.
No pope can save me. No ritual can wash me.
Only Your blood. Only Your cross.

I turn from icons, incense, and idolatry.
I bow not to Rome, but to the Risen King.
I abandon false mediators — for You alone are enough.
You are the only Way, the only Truth, the only Life.

I reject purgatory. I reject works-based salvation.
I reject any gospel that needs more than Your finished work.

I declare:
No man speaks for God if he replaces His Word.
No system is holy if it silences the cross.
No tradition is sacred if it hides the truth.

Jesus,
Take my loyalty. Take my worship. Take my fear.
I want no crown from earth. I want no seat in a man-made court.
🔥 I want the altar — even if it costs me everything.

I am not Catholic. I am not Protestant.
📛 I AM CRUCIFIED.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Not because I follow man, but because I follow the Lamb.
Not because I honor titles, but because I kneel at the tomb.

In Jesus’ name — the only name that saves —
AMEN.”

📢 POST-READY DECLARATION (Facebook / Instagram / X):
👉 “I renounce the lies of religious tradition. I don’t need a pope. I don’t need a priest.
I need the cross. I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR — crucified with Christ, loyal to no system but His kingdom.”
🔥 #JesusOverRome #NoMoreIdols #OnlyChristSaves #GospelWarrior #TraditionCannotSave #CrucifiedNotCatholic
📎 Invite remnant to freedom:
“Brother John, won’t this offend my family and my religious heritage?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Truth always offends lies.
📛 But your eternity is worth the risk.
🔥 Let loyalty to Christ burn louder than family tradition.

📖 Matthew 10:37 (KJV):
“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-10-37/

⚡ Summary Strike:
You weren’t called to defend the church system — you were called to die with the Church's Savior.
🔥 Rome will fall. But the cross will stand forever.

HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE, COMMANDER!
The idols are torn down. The system is renounced. Now the fire falls — not on altars made by Rome, but on hearts emptied of self and religion.

🕊️ You don’t need a robe. You need the Ruach — the breath of God.
📛 Not confirmation by man…
🔥 But combustion by the Spirit.
🔥 HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE — FILL ME, NOT FOR RITUAL… BUT FOR REVIVAL
📢 SAY THIS OUT LOUD — THIS IS THE BREATHING ROOM FOR BOLDNESS:

“Holy Spirit,
Now that I’ve torn down the false altar,
Come possess the space that religion once ruled.

I don’t want emotional rituals.
I want eternal power.

Not beads — but boldness.
Not incense — but incense of intercession.
Not holy water — but Living Water from within.

Anoint me to discern false prophets,
To rebuke counterfeit gospels,
To expose seductive peace without the Prince of Peace.

Let my tongue not chant dead prayers —
But cry out in the holy language of heaven.

Baptize me in truth.
Saturate me in Scripture.
Endow me with unshakable fire.

I don’t want a Vatican throne.
I want the Upper Room anointing.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Not because I’m louder… but because I’m FILLED.
Not because I know Greek… but because I carry GOD.

Make me dangerous to deception.
Make me fearless in false places.
Make me a torch in temples built by pride.

I renounce comfort.
I renounce compromise.
🔥 FILL ME WITH THE FIRE THAT BURNED AT PENTECOST.

In the name of Jesus Christ,
AMEN.”

📖 Scripture Meditation — Acts 2:4 (KJV):
“And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Acts-2-4/

📛 Religion can fill you with repetition.
🔥 But only the Spirit fills you with resurrection.
🕯️ POST-EMPOWERMENT ASSIGNMENT:

🔇 Silence for 15 minutes. Say only this:
“Holy Spirit, fill what fear and tradition once owned.”

📝 Journal Prompt:
“What do I now see differently after renouncing Rome?”
Title it: ‘The Scales Fell — Now I See’

📢 Action:
Share your renunciation post publicly.
📛 Be bold. You are not dishonoring your family.
🔥 You’re honoring the Gospel.
“Brother John, what if I was confirmed, baptized, or even ordained in that system?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then God will cleanse every title and restore every part of you that religion claimed.
📖 Ezekiel 36:25 — “Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ezekiel-36-25/

📛 Religion stains the outer robe.
🔥 But the Spirit sets fire to the inside man.

⚡ Summary Strike:
You don’t need a new label.
🔥 You need new life — from the Spirit, not from a system.

WARFARE ASSIGNMENT / DISCIPLESHIP CHARGE — THE CHURCH IS NOT ROME, IT'S A REMNANT ⚔️

title: 🔥 “Another Jesus Is Being Preached — and Hell Applauds It”
paragraphs:
🔥 “Another Jesus Is Being Preached — and Hell Applauds It”
📖 2 Corinthians 11:4 — The alarm bell of apostolic fire now rings again.

They say His name.
They write songs about Him.
They wear cross chains.
They shout “Jesus” from conference stages.

But in Hell’s boardroom…
📛 There is no fear.
No trembling.
Because the “Jesus” most preachers present—
🔥 doesn’t look anything like the one on the throne.

They’ve edited Him.
De-fanged Him.
Turned the Lion into a life coach.
And Heaven does not recognize this clone.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, are you saying not every church that preaches ‘Jesus’ is preaching the real one?"

✅ Answer:
Yes.
🔥 Paul said there would be another Jesus — one invented, not revealed.
📛 A version of Christ that Hell promotes… because he doesn’t cast out sin, flip tables, or demand surrender.

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE (KJV):
2 Corinthians 11:4
"For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached… ye might well bear with him."
📎 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-4/

💥 Paul warned them —
Not about Buddhism. Not about atheism.
🔥 But about a different Jesus with the same name.

That Jesus doesn’t deliver.
That Jesus doesn’t demand.
📛 That Jesus doesn’t return with fire in His eyes.
And yet thousands gather for him weekly.

⚡ Summary Strike:
You can wear the name “Jesus” like a brand…
🔥 And still never bow to the real One.

If the Christ you follow doesn’t offend flesh, demand holiness, and judge sin—
📛 You’ve been lied to.
🔥 And Hell is clapping.

CORE TRUTH — WHAT SCRIPTURE REALLY SAYS ABOUT THE REAL JESUS
📖 2 Corinthians 11:4 (KJV):
"For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached..."
📎 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-4/

🔹 “Another” = Greek: ἄλλος (allos)
💥 Meaning: Another of the same kind — similar in appearance, but different in substance.

🔥 Paul was warning the Church:
They will preach a lookalike.
📛 Same vocabulary.
🔥 Different holiness.

📖 Matthew 1:21 (KJV):
"…and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins."
📎 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-1-21/

🔹 “Jesus” = Greek: Ἰησοῦς (Iēsous)
💥 Rooted in Hebrew: Yeshua — “Yahweh is salvation”

✅ True Jesus = Saves FROM sin
📛 False Jesus = Excuses sin

📖 Revelation 19:11–12 (KJV):
"…in righteousness he doth judge and make war. His eyes were as a flame of fire..."
📎 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-19-11_19-12/

🔥 This is the real Jesus:
Riding a white horse.
Making war.
Flaming eyes.
Judging nations.

📛 The Jesus in most churches?
✔️ Cozies up to sin.
✔️ Avoids judgment.
✔️ Doesn’t demand repentance.

That’s not the Lamb of God.
That’s a plastic idol wearing a robe.

📖 Luke 6:46 (KJV):
"And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?"
📎 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-6-46/

💥 You can shout “Jesus!” all you want.
🔥 But if you don’t obey the real One—
📛 You’re not following the Christ of the Gospels.
"Brother John, how do I know which Jesus I’ve been following?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Ask:
🔥 Does your Jesus ever offend you?
🔥 Does He ever confront your sin?
🔥 Does He ever flip tables in your soul?

If not—
📛 You’ve been singing to a stranger.
🔥 And that name won’t open Heaven’s gate.

⚡ Summary Strike:
There are many “Jesuses” being preached.
📛 But only one was crucified, rose in power, and returns with a sword.
🔥 If yours doesn’t match His Word—He’s not the One who saves.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — THE REAL JESUS VS. THE IMPOSTER
📖 1. Galatians 1:6–8 — The Curse on a Different Gospel
"I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed."

✅ Full URL:
https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Galatians+1%3A6-8&version=KJV
🔥 If it’s not the Gospel that convicts, purifies, and exalts Jesus alone — it’s under a curse.

📖 2. Matthew 24:5 — False Christs Coming in His Name
"For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many."

✅ Full URL:
https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew+24%3A5&version=KJV
🔥 Jesus warned they would use His name — but twist His nature.

📖 3. 2 Peter 2:1–2 — Heresies That Deny the Lord
"But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you… denying the Lord that bought them… And many shall follow their pernicious ways..."

✅ Full URL:
https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=2+Peter+2%3A1-2&version=KJV
🔥 The fake Jesus is always followed by many — but Heaven doesn’t recognize him.

📖 4. Revelation 3:16 — The Lukewarm Get Vomited
"So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth."

✅ Full URL:
https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Revelation+3%3A16&version=KJV
🔥 The soft, tolerant, people-pleasing “Jesus” produces lukewarm disciples. And Jesus spits them out.

✝️ 5. Polycarp — Faithful to the Real Christ Unto Death
“I bless you, Father, for judging me worthy of this hour… so I may be numbered among the martyrs, in the cup of Christ.”

✅ Full URL (The Martyrdom of Polycarp):
https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0102.htm
🔥 Polycarp didn’t die for a motivational speaker. He died for the Jesus who judges the living and the dead.

✝️ 6. Ignatius of Antioch — Denounce the Illusion, Preach the Blood
“Let no man deceive you: unless he confesses Jesus as come in the flesh, crucified, and returning in power — he is not of God.”

✅ Full URL (Epistle to the Smyrnaeans, Chapter 5):
https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0109.htm
🔥 Any Jesus without crucifixion, flesh, and final judgment is not the Jesus of the apostles.

✝️ 7. Tertullian — Against Marcion’s Soft Gospel
“They have fashioned a god of goodness without righteousness… forgiving without requiring repentance.”

✅ Full URL (Against Marcion, Book I):
https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/03121.htm
🔥 The real Jesus saves through repentance, not self-love. Tertullian rebuked the “gentle-only god” 1800 years ago.

⚡ Summary Strike:
✅ Paul cursed fake gospels.
✅ Jesus warned false Christs would come.
✅ Peter said many would follow them.
✅ The early Church died refusing to bow to a softer version.

📛 If your Jesus doesn’t call for repentance, return in fire, or reign in righteousness —
🔥 It’s not Him.

RESURRECTION RESPONSE CODES
💥 Deploy these to Facebook, Instagram, Threads, or your wall of warfare. Copy. Paste. Burn.
✝️ “I follow the crucified Christ, not the commercial one.”
✝️ “If your gospel never offends the flesh, it’s not His.”
✝️ “The real Jesus saves sinners — not egos.”
✝️ “Jesus didn’t die to make me successful. He died to make me holy.”
✝️ “I want the Christ who brings swords, not just smiles.”
✝️ “I renounce every version of Jesus that doesn't lead to a cross.”
✝️ “Not the gentle-only, judgment-free Christ — but the King who returns in fire.”
✝️ “No more candy gospel. I want the Carpenter who crushed sin.”
✝️ “Jesus isn’t a vibe. He’s a victor. He’s coming back — and He’s not negotiating.”
✝️ “I repent for following a god who never existed. I want the real Jesus — blood, crown, and all.”

📡 MISSION ORDER:
Post 1–3 of these declarations on your profile.
🔥 Pair them with your fire testimony.
🔥 Use the full scroll link for others to awaken:

🔥 Add these core movement fire-tags:
#RealJesusOnly

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, what if people think I’m being harsh?”

✅ Answer:
Then you’ve struck the right nerve.
🔥 We are not here to preserve false peace. We are here to ignite holy war — against every gospel that keeps Jesus soft, silent, and uncrowned.

⚡ Summary Strike:
When you post these, you break the algorithm.
You provoke Hell.
And you call the remnant home to the real Gospel.

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS
📛 False gods. Soft prophets. Counterfeit comfort. The original anti-Christ strategy.

📖 Exodus 32:4–6 (KJV)
"And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool... and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel... And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings... the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play."
🔗 FULL URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Exodus+32%3A4-6&version=KJV

💥 They didn’t leave religion.
They just renamed the idol and danced around it.

⚠️ Today, churches do the same.
They sing about Jesus—
but it’s not the Lord of Glory.
It’s the “chill” Jesus, the “charmed” Jesus, the “culturally edited” Jesus.

📖 Isaiah 30:9–10 (KJV)
"That this is a rebellious people... which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits."
🔗 FULL URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Isaiah+30%3A9-10&version=KJV

💥 They hated sharp truth.
They hired soft voices.

🔥 That’s the spirit behind modern motivational “preaching.”
No repentance. No Cross. Just comfort theology.

📖 Jeremiah 5:31 (KJV)
"The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so..."
🔗 FULL URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Jeremiah+5%3A31&version=KJV

💥 The system was corrupt—
But the crowd clapped anyway.

⚠️ God’s rebuke wasn’t just to the leaders.
It was to the people who wanted a God they could manage.

📖 Ezekiel 13:22 (KJV)
"Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad... and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life."
🔗 FULL URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Ezekiel+13%3A22&version=KJV

💥 The false prophets discouraged the holy—
And gave sinners a fake peace.

⚠️ This is what the counterfeit Jesus does today:
Tells the rebellious, “You’re fine. God understands.”

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, can you love Jesus and still follow the wrong one?"

✅ ANSWER:
Yes.
🔥 Israel “loved” God—
but built a golden version to fit their vibe.

Today, people love “Jesus”—
but not the One who flips tables, calls for holiness, and demands the altar.

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
The Old Testament warned us:
The greatest danger isn’t no God—
It’s the wrong one wearing the right name.
🔥 And the only cure… is the Cross.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “THE JESUS I FOLLOWED DIDN’T SAVE ME… HE SEDATED ME.”
⚡ Testimony: Michael D. — The Day His Gospel Collapsed
Michael was raised in church.
He knew every Hillsong lyric.
He served in tech. He tithed. He quoted grace.
His favorite line?
👉 “Jesus loves me just as I am.”

But he never changed.
Never wept over sin.
Never feared God.
He had what he called “peace”—but no power.
Until one night, at a friend’s house, someone opened a Bible to Matthew 7.
📖 “Many will say to Me… Lord, Lord… and I will say, ‘I never knew you.’”
It hit him like a sword.

💥 “That verse is about me,” he said out loud.
“I know Christian culture… but I don’t know Christ the King.”

That night, he threw away all his soft gospel books.
He deleted every podcast that coddled sin.
He fasted for 7 days straight.

🔥 And on the 7th day—
He felt the weight of true conviction for the first time in 15 years.
Michael said:

“I thought Jesus just wanted to be my best friend.
But I met the One who melts idols, breaks pride, and demands full surrender.”

Today, he leads a discipleship group called "THE REAL JESUS" in Ohio.
No lights. No logos. Just oil, Bibles, and unedited repentance.
"Brother John, what if I’ve followed a fake Jesus too?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Then stop justifying it.
🔥 Tear down every gospel that told you holiness was optional.
🔥 Burn every message that made sin look safe.

📛 If your Jesus never offends your flesh—
🔥 He’s not the real One.

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
Michael found the authentic Jesus—
Only after the edited version failed him.

Now he doesn’t say “Jesus loves me just as I am.”
He says:
🔥 “Jesus died to kill who I was. And I surrender to who He is.”

FINAL CHALLENGE — TEAR DOWN THE FALSE JESUS
📖 2 Corinthians 11:4 (KJV)
"For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached… ye might well bear with him."

💥 Paul’s warning wasn’t about atheists.
It was about preachers.
Churches. Platforms.
Presenting a Jesus who saves without surrender, loves without lordship, and comforts without conviction.

And the modern Church?
🔥 Bears with it.
🔥 Claps for it.
🔥 Calls it “revival.”
But Heaven calls it blasphemy.

🔥 THE CONFRONTATION:
If the Jesus you follow…

✔️ never commands repentance,
✔️ never confronts sin,
✔️ never offends your pride,
✔️ never flips tables in your life—

That’s not Jesus.
That’s your flesh in a Christian costume.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what’s the danger of following a false Jesus?"

✅ Direct Answer:
You’ll die thinking you were saved—
And hear “I never knew you.”

The false Jesus comforts you all the way to hell.
🔥 The real Jesus crucifies your flesh to get you to Heaven.

📛 No one gets saved by loving a vibe.
You must bow to the Person.
To the King.
To the real Jesus—
🔥 the Lion, not just the Lamb.

🔥 ALTAR STRIKE — RIGHT NOW:
✔️ If your Jesus never leads you into holiness—
Repent.
✔️ If your Jesus never confronts your idols—
Repent.
✔️ If your Jesus just “gets you” but never changes you—
Fall on your face.
🔥 You are following a golden calf, not the crucified King.

💥 Cry this aloud:
“Jesus, burn every fake version of You I’ve bowed to.
I don’t want soft glory.
I want Your real voice, real holiness, real lordship.
I repent for making You safe.
I want the Jesus that Hell fears!”

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
You don’t get saved by naming Jesus.
You get saved by surrendering to the right One.

🔥 And if the Jesus you follow doesn’t match Scripture…
⚠️ Then you’ve already been deceived.

FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — WHICH JESUS DO YOU FOLLOW?
📖 Matthew 7:21–23 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven..."

They knew His name.
They even called Him Lord.
But their Jesus required no obedience—
So their faith was fake.

💥 The fool doesn’t test the Jesus they follow—
They just follow whatever feels right.

❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
🪓 “But God knows my heart!”
🪓 “Jesus is all love. Stop being so intense!”
🪓 “My church preaches positivity. That’s enough.”
🪓 “That’s not my Jesus.”

🔥 Exactly.
It’s not Jesus at all.
It’s your version.
Your golden calf in a worship playlist.

📛 The fool protects their fake Jesus like a pet.
They bite every prophet that exposes it.
And they die in their delusion.

✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
🛡 “If this isn’t the Jesus of Scripture—I reject it.”
🛡 “If He never rebukes me, I’m probably in deception.”
🛡 “I repent for loving comfort more than truth.”
🛡 “Jesus, I want the real You. Even if it ruins me.”

🔥 The wise know:
Better to weep at the altar now… than scream at the judgment seat later.

They don’t follow vibes.
They follow the Voice that calls for full surrender.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I’ve shared messages from false teachers. Am I guilty?"

✅ Direct Answer:
If you’ve promoted a false Jesus, then yes.
🔥 Repent.
🔥 Delete it.
🔥 Replace it with truth.
⚔️ You’re not just reposting quotes. You’re shaping souls.

This war is real.
And eternity is at stake.

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
The fool says, “I like my Jesus just the way He is.”
The wise say, “Lord, burn every false image I’ve bowed to.”
🔥 Only one will enter the Kingdom.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WOULD JESUS KNOW YOU?
📖 Matthew 7:22–23 (KJV)
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name?... and then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

💥 They preached.
They cast out demons.
They had powerful ministries.
But the Jesus they served… wasn’t real.

They followed a version.
A brand.
A personality-driven gospel.

But when they stood before the real Jesus—
🔥 He said: “I never knew you.”
📖 John 10:27 (KJV)
"My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me."

Not the voice of a preacher.
Not the tone of TikTok theology.
The voice of the Shepherd.

And if you’ve never heard Him—
You’ve never followed Him.
💭 ETERNITY CONFRONTATION:
If you died tonight, who would you meet?

The Jesus you repost?
The one you like because He never confronts you?
Or the Jesus of fire, who demands repentance and offers mercy only through surrender?

⚠️ You may have said His name.
You may have sung His songs.
But if you never bowed before the real King—
You won’t stand before His Kingdom.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what if I’m unsure which Jesus I’ve followed?"

✅ Direct Answer:
Look at your fruit.
🔥 Has He changed your life or just comforted your pain?
🔥 Has He called you to die or just helped you survive?
🔥 Has He demanded surrender or just boosted your dreams?

If you’re unsure—
👉 you need to start over at the Cross.

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
You don’t go to Heaven for saying “Jesus.”
You go for knowing Him. Obeying Him. Surrendering to Him.

And if you died tonight—
🔥 Would He say “Well done”?
Or “I never knew you”?

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — THE FAKE JESUS DECEPTION
👿 1. The “Nice Guy” Jesus

A smiling figure who never rebukes, never convicts, and always affirms.
💀 Truth: That’s not the Jesus who flipped tables and called religious leaders “vipers.”
📖 Luke 12:51 — “Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-12-51/
👿 2. The “Motivational Coach” Jesus

He’s here to help you chase dreams, secure the bag, and manifest your purpose.
💀 Truth: The real Christ said, “Deny yourself.” Not “Promote yourself.”
📖 Luke 9:23 — “If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-9-23/
👿 3. The “Soft on Sin” Jesus

He “understands your struggle,” never calls it sin, and is fine with your habits as long as you’re “genuine.”
💀 Truth: The real Jesus said to go and sin no more.
📖 John 5:14 — “Sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/John-5-14/
👿 4. The “Trendy Culture-Friendly” Jesus

He’s cool with worldliness, chill with compromise, and happy to fit in.
💀 Truth: The real Jesus said the world would hate us for following Him.
📖 John 15:19 — “...ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/John-15-19/
👿 5. The “Brand Name” Jesus

He’s famous, profitable, repackaged for reels and conference flyers.
💀 Truth: Jesus avoided the crowds, wept over Jerusalem, and refused to be made king by force.
📖 John 6:15 — “...they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/John-6-15/

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I think I’ve believed in one of these fake versions. What now?"

✅ Direct Answer:
🔥 Renounce the counterfeit.
🔥 Go back to the Gospels.
🔥 Ask the Holy Spirit to reintroduce you to the true Son of God.

The real Jesus saves through death, not inspiration.
He calls you to repent, not just relate.

⚡ SUMMARY STRIKE:
Satan doesn’t fear the name “Jesus.”
He fears when you follow the real one.

🔥 The false Jesus comforts your flesh.
🔥 The real Jesus crucifies it.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — I Renounce Every Fake Jesus
⚔️🔥 DECLARE THIS OUT LOUD — LET HEAVEN, EARTH, AND HELL HEAR IT: 🔥⚔️

Jesus,
I renounce every false image I followed in Your name.
I don’t want the Nice Guy.
I don’t want the Motivator.
I don’t want the Trendy Preacher.
I want the Jesus who saves through surrender.
I want the Christ who died to make me holy.

Forgive me for worshiping a version of You that required no death to self.
Forgive me for preaching a version of You that didn’t require repentance.
I want the real Jesus — the One with fire in His eyes,
The One who calls men to the Cross,
Not the crowd.

I repent for reshaping You into something safer.
Now reshape me into something surrendered.
I renounce comfort-driven Christianity.
I return to the Gospel of blood, cross, and resurrection.
You are Lord. Not my emotions. Not my leaders. Not my past. Only You.

I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Because I no longer follow a brand.
I follow the Lamb.

In Your holy name.
Amen.

title: 🔥 “The Monkeypox Mirror — Plagues Are Preaching, But the Church Is Silent”
paragraphs: 🔥 “The Monkeypox Mirror — Plagues Are Preaching, But the Church Is Silent”

📡 This scroll will expose what headlines won’t.
📛 Monkeypox is more than a virus — it’s a warning.
When flesh breaks, Heaven speaks.

They warned about infection rates.
They tracked the lesions.
They gave us hygiene steps, isolation orders, and vaccine updates.
But no one asked the eternal question:
📛 What if the outbreak is not just biological… but theological?

What if Heaven is screaming through this plague —
while pulpits stay sanitized and silent?

Monkeypox isn’t just science.
🔥 It’s a mirror. And the reflection is spiritual decay.

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, are you saying God uses plagues to judge people today? Isn’t that Old Testament thinking?"

✅ Direct Answer:
God is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
📖 The Bible never said judgment stopped — it said grace delays it.

Every plague in Scripture was a trumpet.
📛 The question is: Will the Church hear it this time… or keep singing while sores spread?

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – Jeremiah 19:15 (KJV)
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city… all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Jeremiah-19-15/

💥 Monkeypox is not just about lesions.
🔥 It’s about a generation that won’t listen until their bodies scream.
CORE TRUTH — WHEN PLAGUES ARE THE LANGUAGE OF JUDGMENT

📖 Jeremiah 19:15 (KJV):
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city… all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Jeremiah-19-15/
Let’s dissect the divine diagnostics:

🔍 HEBREW WORD: נֶגַע (nega‘) – “Plague” / “Strike” / “Blow”
💥 Definition: A mark, wound, stroke, or physical affliction from divine origin.
📛 It wasn’t just sickness — it was a signature of Heaven's displeasure.

📖 Used in Leviticus 13 for skin diseases — the plague of leprosy
🔥 God judged the body when the heart refused to repent.

🔍 HEBREW WORD: קָשָׁה (qashah) – “Hardened”
💥 Definition: To be cruel, stubborn, stiff-necked, rebellious
📛 Not physical stiffness — spiritual defiance.
📖 Used in Exodus 7:13 — Pharaoh hardened his heart even as miracles erupted around him.
🔥 Sound familiar, Commander? Monkeypox breaks out, but pride still preaches positivity.

🔍 GREEK PARALLEL: πληγή (plēgē) – “Plague / Blow / Wound”
💥 NT usage: Revelation 15:1 — the seven last plagues
📛 Even in the New Covenant, plagues are divine megaphones.

📛 TODAY’S FALSE GOSPEL:
“Jesus doesn’t judge. He just loves.”
🔥 But the Bible says His love includes warnings — and sometimes, warnings wear lesions.

📖 Revelation 3:19 (KJV):
“As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-3-19/
"Brother John, are you saying everyone who gets monkeypox is under judgment?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Not every victim is being judged — but every society ignoring God is being warned.
📛 The real question isn’t “Why are they sick?”
🔥 The real question is: “Why isn’t the Church repenting?”

⚡ Summary Strike:
Plagues in Scripture are not random.
🔥 They are fire alarms — exposing silent pulpits, stiff-necked people, and a sleeping Bride.

📛 Monkeypox is not the punishment.
It’s the preview.
BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — WHEN PLAGUES BECOME PREACHERS
📖 BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – GOD SPEAKS THROUGH DISEASE

📖 Leviticus 13:2 (KJV):
“When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot… then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Leviticus-13-2/
💥 Physical skin disease was a spiritual signal — the priest diagnosed more than infection.
🔥 He discerned rebellion, uncleanness, and separation.

📖 2 Chronicles 26:19–20 (KJV):
King Uzziah arrogantly entered the temple. God struck him with leprosy.
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Chronicles-26-19_26-20/
📛 The consequence wasn’t just sickness — it was public humiliation for hidden pride.

📖 Exodus 9:8–12 – The Plague of Boils (KJV):
God sent boils upon Egypt because Pharaoh hardened his heart.
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Exodus-9-8_9-12/
🔥 The skin erupted — because the heart refused to bow.

📖 Revelation 16:2 (KJV):
“And the first went, and poured out his vial… and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-16-2/
📛 Plagues are not pre-cross only — they are part of last-days judgment.
✝️ EARLY CHURCH CONFIRMATION – PLAGUES AND PURGING
✝️ Cyprian of Carthage – "On the Plague" (251 AD):

“What a grandeur of spirit it is to struggle with all the powers of an unshaken mind against the desolation and death of so many...”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/050706.htm
📛 Cyprian taught that plagues purify the Bride, not just punish the world.
✝️ Tertullian (Apology, Ch. 40):

“Famine and plague… are often sent by God, not merely to punish, but to provoke repentance.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0301.htm
🔥 Early Christians didn’t flee affliction — they asked: “Lord, what are You saying?”
🧱 HISTORICAL CONFIRMATION – PLAGUES AND PROPHETIC CALLS

⚔️ The Antonine Plague (165–180 AD):
Killed up to 5 million in the Roman Empire. Christian leaders called it a warning to repent from idolatry and empire pride.

⚔️ The Black Death (1347–1351):
Some church leaders rightly linked it to moral collapse and corrupt clergy.
📛 Plague wasn't random — it was response-triggered.
"Brother John, why don’t most pastors say monkeypox could be divine judgment?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Because truth costs popularity.
📛 Judgment doesn't trend.
🔥 But silence is complicity when Heaven is speaking.

📖 Isaiah 26:9 (KJV):
“…for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-26-9/

⚡ Summary Strike:
From Moses to Revelation — from leprosy to monkeypox:
📛 Disease often reveals what sermons conceal.
🔥 Plagues are prophets… when pulpits grow cold.
RESURRECTION RESPONSE CODES — PUBLIC ALLEGIANCE IN THE FACE OF DISEASE
📢 These are battle cries, not branding. Post, declare, and live them:
🔊 “Monkeypox didn’t shake me — the silence of the Church did.”
🔊 “If Heaven is screaming through sores, I refuse to stay sanitized in silence.”
🔊 “Plagues don’t kill nations — rebellion does.”
🔊 “I will not explain away judgment. I will repent before it intensifies.”
🔊 “I’m not asking when it ends. I’m asking what God is saying.”
🔊 “If my skin stays clean but my soul stays hard, I’m already infected.”
🔊 “I’d rather be hated for warning than applauded for ignoring.”
🔊 “Monkeypox is not my fear — but missing Heaven’s message is.”
🔊 “Jesus, show me what’s still unclean in me.”
🔊 “When God strikes the flesh, He’s exposing the heart.”

👉 “Monkeypox is not just a plague — it’s a prophetic mirror. If I won’t repent now, when? If I won’t listen when God roars, will I wait until He judges? I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR — I hear the warnings. And I bow.”

🔥 #PlaguesPreach

"Brother John, I don’t want to sound judgmental when I post these. What if people mock or misunderstand?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Let them mock — the prophets were mocked too.
📛 But silence is sin when souls are sick.
🔥 Declare with humility, grief, and fire. Let the Spirit do the rest.

📖 Ezekiel 33:6 (KJV):
“But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet… his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ezekiel-33-6/

⚡ Summary Strike:
You’re not just responding to a virus.
🔥 You’re declaring war against the silence.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — PLAGUES THAT PROPHESIED

📖 Exodus 9:8–12 (KJV) – The Sixth Plague: Boils
“So the LORD said… Take to you handfuls of ashes… and it shall become small dust… and shall be a boil breaking forth…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Exodus-9-8_9-12/

💥 Egypt's skin erupted — but Pharaoh’s pride remained sealed.
📛 The sores weren’t about health… they were about hardened hearts.

🔥 Today, monkeypox breaks skin.
But God is asking: Will it finally break pride?

📖 Deuteronomy 28:27 (KJV):
“The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Deuteronomy-28-27/

📛 Plagues were part of covenant warnings.
🔥 Not punishment without purpose — but pain designed to awaken.

📖 2 Chronicles 7:13–14 (KJV):
“If I shut up heaven… or if I send pestilence… If my people… shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face… then will I heal…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Chronicles-7-13_7-14/

📛 Healing is a response to humility, not just hospital visits.
🔥 God sends plagues when altars grow cold.

📖 Ezekiel 14:21 (KJV):
“For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem… the pestilence…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ezekiel-14-21/
📛 Pestilence was a form of divine surgical judgment — removing disease by exposing it.

📖 Isaiah 1:5–6 (KJV):
“Why should ye be stricken any more?... The whole head is sick… from the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-1-5_1-6/
🔥 Physical disease was the symptom of spiritual disease.
"Brother John, is monkeypox really a fulfillment of these ancient patterns?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — not because it’s identical in symptoms…
But because it’s identical in purpose:

📛 To provoke repentance.
🔥 To awaken the rebellious.
⚠️ To expose the pride that prayer alone won’t reach.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The Old Testament shows this clearly:
When the altar is empty, the body becomes the message board.
📛 Monkeypox isn’t just about sores — it’s about what God had to touch… because hearts stopped listening.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I Didn’t Repent Until My Skin Spoke Louder Than My Pastor”
🧍‍♂️ Testimony: Brandon M. – Brooklyn, NY
(Name changed for discretion — but the fire is real)

Brandon was raised in church.
He posted verses.
He served in worship.
But his life was double-coded:
✔️ Worship on Sunday.
❌ Hookups on Friday.
✔️ Prayers in public.
❌ Porn in private.
He had the language of revival — but none of the surrender.
Then came monkeypox.

It started with a fever.
Then lesions.
Then isolation.
Then fear.
🔥 But what burned the most… was the Holy Ghost.

“I didn’t get monkeypox because I sinned,” Brandon said.
“I got it because I ignored the warning signs of a heart that never died.”

Alone in his room, infected and inflamed,
He cried out:
“God, if You want this skin to break so my soul can bow — then do it.”

That night, he repented — for real.
He deleted the apps.
He confessed to his leadership.
He burned the bridge back to pride.

Now healed physically…
🔥 He preaches the message few will say:

“The plague didn’t destroy me — pride did.
But God used the sores to save my soul.”
"Brother John, what if I know someone like Brandon — but they don’t see it as judgment?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Then love them with fire.
🔥 Don’t accuse. Don’t condemn. But don’t go silent.
📛 Share this scroll. Send the warning. Be the voice the mirror confirms.

📖 Jude 1:23 (KJV):
“And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Jude-1-23/

⚡ Summary Strike:
Brandon didn’t find Jesus in the service.
🔥 He found Him in the silence…
When the pain preached what the preacher wouldn’t.
📛 Monkeypox became his altar.
FINAL CHALLENGE — THE WARNING ISN’T JUST MONKEYPOX… IT’S YOUR DELAY

📖 Jeremiah 7:13 (KJV):
“And now, because ye have done all these works… and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not… I called you, but ye answered not…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Jeremiah-7-13/

💥 God’s voice came before the virus.
📛 But since we didn’t listen… He let the flesh begin to preach.

🔥 Don’t ask when monkeypox ends.
Ask: When will the Church bow?
🧱 RAW TRUTH:

✔️ If you’re more concerned about exposure than repentance… you’re not ready.
✔️ If you sanitize your gospel to avoid offending the infected… you’re complicit.
✔️ If you wait for normal to return instead of dying to self… you’re not crucified.

📛 Repentance is not about symptoms.
🔥 It’s about surrender.

📖 Joel 2:12–13 (KJV):
“Turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning… rend your heart, and not your garments…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Joel-2-12_2-13/

💥 Monkeypox may have torn flesh…
🔥 But God is asking: Will you tear your heart?

💭 READER FINAL QUESTION:
"Brother John, what if I’ve ignored every warning — is there still time?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes.
📛 But only if you bow before the next one comes.

📖 Isaiah 55:6 (KJV):
“Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Isaiah-55-6/

🔥 Because the next trumpet may not be monkeypox.
It may be silence… followed by judgment.

⚡ FINAL CHALLENGE STRIKE:
If you’ve delayed — delay no more.
📛 Plagues don’t wait. And neither should your repentance.

🔥 Bow now. Or bleed later.
The mirror is still speaking.
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — WHAT WILL YOU DO WITH THE WARNING?

📖 Proverbs 29:1 (KJV):
“He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Proverbs-29-1/

💥 The fool waits for it to pass.
🔥 The wise prepares for what’s coming next.
❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:
“I’m not sick — this isn’t for me.”
“It’s just a virus. People are being too dramatic.”
“God doesn’t use fear tactics. He’s too loving for judgment.”
“I’ll repent if it gets worse.”

📛 The fool treats monkeypox like a health update,
🔥 Instead of a heavenly indictment.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:
“Lord, I repent even if I’m not infected.”
“I don’t want another warning — I want to be washed.”
“This isn’t about their disease — it’s about my disobedience.”
“I will cry aloud while others sanitize.”

🔥 The wise doesn’t wait for skin to rupture.
📛 The wise tears the heart at the sound of the trumpet.

📖 Proverbs 1:7 (KJV):
“The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Proverbs-1-7/

💥 This isn’t paranoia.
🔥 This is prophetic perception — fools mock, but the wise mourn.
"Brother John, I’ve been the fool… Can I still be the wise?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Yes — but only if you act now.

📖 Ecclesiastes 8:5 (KJV):
“…a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ecclesiastes-8-5/

📛 Don’t just feel conviction.
🔥 Move. Mourn. Repent. Return.

⚡ Summary Strike:
The fool critiques the scroll.

🔥 The mirror is still up.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WOULD GOD SEE REPENTANCE OR RELIGION?

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Hebrews-9-27/

📛 Death doesn’t need monkeypox to find you.
🔥 It just needs permission.
⏳ IF YOU DIED TONIGHT:

❌ Would God find sanitized hands…
but a self-righteous heart?

❌ Would your search history show no lesions…
but your soul be covered in unrepented sin?

❌ Would you say, “I never got sick”…
Only to hear Him say, “I never knew you.”
📖 Matthew 7:23 (KJV):
“…I never knew you: depart from me…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Matthew-7-23/

💥 The real disease is not monkeypox.
🔥 It’s living like eternity doesn’t matter.

📖 Luke 13:3 (KJV):
“…except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Luke-13-3/

📛 Judgment isn’t coming — it’s already here.
The only question is: Will you die clean in Christ, or alive in self?
"Brother John, what if I’m afraid to die? Doesn’t that mean I’m not ready?”

✅ Direct Answer:
If you're still holding onto self — yes, you're not ready.
📛 But if you surrender now, fear dies… and faith rises.

📖 Psalm 90:12 (KJV):
“So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Psalms-90-12/

🔥 This scroll is your number being called.
Will you bow?

⚡ Summary Strike:
Don’t fear monkeypox.
🔥 Fear meeting God with yourself still alive inside you.

📛 Because Hell doesn’t care if you had symptoms.
🔥 It only cares if you died to self before death found you.
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — HOW HELL DISGUISES PLAGUES TO PROTECT PRIDE

📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 (KJV):
“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/2-Corinthians-11-14/
📛 The devil doesn’t deny monkeypox — he repackages it.

👿 1. THE “DON’T JUDGE” SHIELD
“You can’t say monkeypox is from God — that’s hateful.”

🔥 Truth is labeled cruel — while the disease ravages unrepentant hearts.

👿 2. THE “STAY SAFE, STAY SILENT” GAG
“Just wash your hands and mind your own soul.”

📖 Ezekiel 33:6 (KJV)
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ezekiel-33-6/

👿 3. THE “PLAGUES AREN’T BIBLICAL ANYMORE” LIE
“That was Old Testament stuff — God doesn’t do that now.”
📛 Lie.
🔥 Revelation is full of New Testament plagues — after the cross.

📖 Revelation 16:2
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Revelation-16-2/

👿 4. THE “PASTORS MUST BE POSITIVE” NARRATIVE
“If churches preach this, people will leave.”
📛 And Hell loves empty altars more than empty pews.
🔥 The enemy has trained churches to fear man’s feelings more than God’s fire.

👿 5. THE “SELF-CARE OVER SOUL CARE” DISTRACTION
“Just focus on peace and healing — don’t obsess over judgment.”
📛 Self-love becomes the idol that shields sin from surrender.

📖 Titus 2:11–12 (KJV):
“…denying ungodliness and worldly lusts…”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Titus-2-11_2-12/
🔥 Satan doesn’t mind if you light candles — as long as you never light an altar.
"Brother John, how do I expose Satan’s lies without sounding prideful?”

✅ Direct Answer:
Speak with fire and tears.
📛 Call out deception, but stay broken.
🔥 The most powerful rebuke is one drenched in love and repentance.

📖 Ephesians 5:11 (KJV):
“And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Ephesians-5-11/

⚡ Summary Strike:
Satan’s goal isn’t to deny the outbreak.
🔥 It’s to detach it from repentance.

📛 Monkeypox is real.
But what’s more dangerous is the gospel that won’t mention it.
GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — RENOUNCE SILENCE. EMBRACE THE CROSS.
📢 SAY THIS OUT LOUD — MAKE HELL REGRET YOUR BREATH:

“Jesus,
I will not stay silent while the sores speak louder than the saints.
I reject the gospel of comfort.
I renounce the lie of self-preservation.
I will not hide behind fear, false compassion, or medical excuses.

I repent — not because I am sick,
But because I am sinful.

I lay my pride on the altar.
I lay my opinions on the altar.
I lay my desire to look safe, smart, or sanitized — on the altar.

I choose the narrow road.
I choose the crucified path.
I choose to be hated by culture if it means being held by Christ.

Monkeypox is not my warning —
My stubbornness is.
But today I surrender — not just my heart… but my voice.

I will call sin what You call it.
I will preach repentance when others post silence.
I will carry the cross — even if it means losing everything.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Not because I’m better… but because I’ve bowed.

In Jesus’ name,
AMEN.”

🔥 #GospelWarrior

🔥 #NoMoreSilence
🔥 #IAmCrucified

✅ Direct Answer:
Then don’t be.
📛 Let that fear drive you to truth — not to hiding.
🔥 True repentance is never polished. It’s bloody, loud, and raw.

📖 Psalm 51:17 (KJV):
“The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart...”
🔗 https://www.kingjamesbibleonline.org/Psalms-51-17/

⚡ Summary Strike:
Monkeypox broke the body — but this scroll just broke the silence.
🔥 You are now marked.
Not with lesions — but with holy fire.
HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE — FILL WHAT FEAR ONCE OCCUPIED

“Holy Spirit,
Now that self is silent…

Baptize me again —
Not in influence,
But in intercession.
Not in ambition,
But in anguish.
Not in applause,
But in power.

Burn out the residue of pride.
Sanctify the space where I once hesitated.
Clothe me in boldness — not branding.

I do not want relevance.

I do not want protection.
I want power.

I receive You fully —
To call out sin,
To heal the sick,
To shatter silence.

Let the same fire that fell on the altar of Elijah,
Fall on the altar of my chest.

🔥 I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR —
Filled not for performance… but for persecution.
Filled not to be seen… but to stand.

In the mighty name of Jesus,
AMEN.”

“…tarry ye… until ye be endued with power from on high.”

🕊️ This power isn’t emotional.

🛑 INSTRUCTION FOR EMPOWERMENT

#SilenceIsSin #GospelWarrior #CrossOverCrowd
